title: macOS 26.3 (Tahoe) - IME candidate window not displaying in textarea
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

Electron Version: 35.7.5 (also tested 31.7.7, 33.4.11)

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 26.3

### What arch are you using?

arm64 (including Apple Silicon)

### Last Known Working Electron version

35.7.5

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

When typing Chinese (using IME input methods such as Pinyin) inside a textarea in an Electron application on macOS, the IME candidate window should:

* Display correctly under or near the text cursor
* Show full candidate list (not only pre-edit text / pinyin)
* Follow the caret position accurately during typing
* Behave consistently with native applications and Chrome browser

### Actual Behavior

On macOS (26.3 / Tahoe), when using Electron (tested with Electron 31 - Electron 35) with a minimal reproduction project:

* IME input still works (pinyin composition is visible)
* However, the candidate window does not display correctly
    * In some cases, only the pinyin/pre-edit text is shown
    * Candidate list is missing or not rendered
    * Candidate window may appear empty or not attached to the input field
* The issue persists even in a minimal Electron application with a single <textarea> and no custom CSS or layout
* The same input method works correctly in Google Chrome on the same system

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

* Reproducible in a minimal Electron application with only a single textarea element (no frameworks, no custom CSS, no layout complexity).
* Issue persists after testing multiple Electron versions (Electron 31 - Electron 35).
* Disabling CSS entirely (removing all styles) does not resolve the issue.
* Disabling GPU acceleration, changing backgroundThrottling, and other webPreferences flags do not affect the behavior.
* Same IME input method works correctly in:
    * Google Chrome (latest version on macOS)
    * Native macOS applications
* Suggests issue is specific to Electron/Chromium rendering path on macOS IME integration layer rather than application code or styling.
* Input composition (pre-edit text / pinyin) is correctly received, indicating IME is functional; only candidate window rendering/attachment is affected.
* Likely related to macOS IME candidate window attachment behavior in Electron’s Chromium-based web input pipeline under macOS 26.x (Tahoe).
